extra: The first public release of Astra Browser — a privacy-first browser built in India for a faster, safer, and more focused web experience.
features: Clean, focused interface with light and dark themes
Windows x86_64 and ARM64 installer support
Built for speed, security, and everyday browsing

fixes: Compact Mode now collapses the top toolbar together with the sidebar when the AI Sidebar is open (previously only the sidebar tucked in)
Hovering away from the sidebar after opening the AI Sidebar now correctly re-collapses the toolbar again
